headline: Commercial banks in 2026 are issuing cheaper loans for terms over 3 years than a year ago – 14.20% versus 16.16% » Gazeta.kg - Kyrgyzstan and Bishkek news today
summary: The weighted average rate on Kyrgyz commercial bank loans with terms over three years was 14.20% in January–September 2026, down from 16.16% a year earlier, per Tazabek calculations.
why: Lending rates shape credit demand and borrowing costs in the economy and reflect monetary conditions set by the central bank.
